name: Never Give Up
overview: Scripture encourages believers to remain steadfast and courageous, trusting in God's continual presence and strength as seen in Joshua 1:9 and Isaiah 41:10. The promise that God’s plans are for our good and hope, not harm, in Jeremiah 29:11, assures us that perseverance aligns with His purpose. Jesus' declaration in Matthew 19:26 reminds us that what seems impossible for man is possible with God, while Proverbs 27:17 highlights the importance of godly fellowship in strengthening one another to never give up.
